name: shopify
title: Shopify store audit (GraphQL Admin API)
description: Products, collections and URL redirects from a Shopify store: missing SEO titles/descriptions, duplicate titles, images without alt, thin descriptions, empty collections, redirect chains and loops.
setup: Create a custom app in the Shopify admin (Settings > Apps and sales channels > Develop apps) with read_products + read_online_store_navigation, install it, then set SHOPIFY_STORE=myshop.myshopify.com and SHOPIFY_ADMIN_TOKEN. Optional SHOPIFY_API_VERSION (default 2025-10).
